1. Apprehending arrest in connection with C.R.No.473 of 2023 registered with Pimpri police station for the offence punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC') and under Section 4 and 8 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (for short 'POCSO Act").

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The applicant seeking relief under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (for short 'Cr.P.C.).
2. Prima facie, it appears that the alleged incident occurred between 14 February 2021 to 19 February 2021.
The report is lodged on 24 April 2023.
Earlier report lodged by the informant dated 18 April 2023 alleges assault by the applicant.
In the said report, the incident of 14 February 2021 to 19 February 2021 is absent.
Hence, the applicant has made out prima facie case.

3. Issue notice to respondent No.2, returnable on 17 July 2023.
